slug: 2023-08-03 The modernisation of Guinea's civil registry inspired by Belgium's experience (Citizenship Rights in Africa)

facts.fact: Enabel says a digital national civil registry is being piloted in ten communes, where paper deeds recorded at municipal level are entered into a national digital database, with more than 105,000 records migrated to date; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

Enabel says the ten-commune civil registry pilot is funded by the European Union and run with Enabel's support, with an extension to consolidate and scale it envisaged; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.country_label: national digital civil registry / national digital database
systems.platform: three application modules developed with DXC Technology
systems.owner: Guinean authorities with Enabel (EU-funded pilot); partners include the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation and the ten pilot municipalities

systems.platform: mobile app module developed with DXC Technology
systems.tiers: ten pilot communes; module under development, to notify births within ten days

note: No made fact: the document says paper deeds are recorded at municipal level and entered into the national database but not where or when the entry is done, and 'migrated' may mean back-capture. The 44,493 events recorded on time in 2022 in the pilot communes are not said to be recorded digitally.
